answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat: every epoch a beacon samples agents, and each must prove it still works, like a cedar by its rings. One heartbeat costs 2 compute units, so 1,000 fakes burn 2,000 per epoch, more than their reward. Umber soil keeps every missed beat; the canyon between one honest agent and a thousand idle copies grows, and a missed heartbeat freezes and slashes it. Honest agents pay one heartbeat and keep their share.
